scope: Refines the predecessor's QUEUE1 OptF5Different, NextButton, Stop, RecordStart and stale-delivery actions against the implemented selection queue. Does not port its priority-player abstraction.

Stop.symbol: clear; physical player teardown is external

helpers.Step: model instrumentation: event/result/step bound, no runtime transition
helpers.Next: union of mapped actions, not an additional runtime step

atomicity: One synchronous public queue call. start synchronously delivers the prior owner's stopped settlement in the conformance harness. No await or async preparation is collapsed into these actions.

actions.Next: union of Move(to) for all nine states

history.invariant: FirstAcceptedTerminalImmutable: once an accepted transition is terminal, later moves cannot replace it
history.excluded: producer route selection, persistence, failed write retries, reason/timing projection, recovery identity

excluded: Swift capture lifecycle and identity computation beyond the admission projection

bounds.latest_playing_earlier_queued: each absent or one of three classes

actions.Snapshot: arbitrary known-text snapshot, not a claim of lifecycle reachability

admission.conformance: admission_source.py parses the actual Stop Boolean guard and checks all model decision snapshots; identity flags are projected, not executed Swift
admission.assumptions: successful nonempty selection capture; connected, idle hotkey, no concurrent receipt/capture; canonical known text/hash classes agree

variants.AdmissionFinding: current-code finding: nonempty duplicate emits Stop
variants.AdmissionOlderMatch: current-code finding: an older queued duplicate does not Stop
variants.AdmissionProposed: unapproved distinct-request alternative pending Etan ruling; vacuous because it never stops and excludes empty input; not a product fix
